findings.name: partial-header test transient zero-byte fixture race

findings.name: QA configuration symlink escaped private fixture
findings.cause: My outer conf symlink was copied as a symlink by migration fixture; fixture write reached shared conf/projects.json. Main restored HEAD.
findings.fix: Removed own symlink and created physical private conf copy. Shared projects file has no own final diff. Successful subsequent unit uses physical copy.
findings.childCancellation: Interrupted wait did not prove child termination. Main subsequently confirmed no active/pending raf test process before GREEN was launched. No pass was inferred for the interrupted request.
